question: Goal-line field goal or go (late with a lead, early in a close game), and the extra point or two after a touchdown, from the exact game solution
method: exact backward induction on the M4 game model; see docs/notes/m4_mdp.md and docs/notes/m13_goal_line_and_two_point.md

assumptions.teams: identical league-average teams; both play the model's optimal policy
assumptions.two_point_rate_source: share of two-point attempts that succeeded in the development seasons (components bundle); one rate for every team and situation
assumptions.touchdown_chance_source: the fourth-down play-outcome model (M1) at that yard line; one rate for every team and situation
assumptions.no_overtime: a tie after regulation is worth 0.5
assumptions.hypothetical: the 2026 cases quoted on X are in the sealed holdout season and are rebuilt here as hypothetical states; no 2026 data is read

one_shot_two_point_shift.note: only this try's success probability changed, later tries as in the base model (the sensitivity rows re-solve the whole game instead)

score_arithmetic_on_its_own_path.assumes: the trailing team scores exactly one more touchdown, the leader scores nothing more, a tie is worth 0.5 (the model has no overtime)

grid.axes: [seconds][margin][yardline], averaged over who receives the second-half kickoff

sensitivity.scenario: defense calls timeouts at measured rates (41% to 93%), not optimally

sensitivity_note: each row re-solves the whole game in memory with one assumption changed (data/mdp is not written); values are exact for that changed model

coach_counts_development_seasons.source: splits.load_dev_plays(), seasons 2010 to 2023; no test or holdout season is read

late_goal_line.what: fourth and goal from the 1 to 3, fourth quarter, 2:00 to 12:00 left, leading by the listed amounts; go or field goal only

early_goal_line.what: fourth and goal from the 1 to 3, first half, within 3 points

tries_fourth_quarter.what: tries in the fourth quarter, seasons 2015 to 2023, by the margin before the try; share that went for two (penalty-replayed tries count once per snap)

public_numbers_quoted_not_ours.ryan_paganetti_bowles_case: conversion at the 1 about 57.6% (200 of 347), about 54-55% without a sneak; a touchdown to go up 21 wins over 99%; a failure, up 14, about 96%; a made field goal (over 99% likely) about 98.5%; he would have kicked
public_numbers_quoted_not_ours.paganetti_go_for_two_down_8: used 53 times by 23 franchises since 2018; in 2025 teams went for two in this situation in the fourth quarter roughly half the time
